grammar.title: Relative clauses with 的
grammar.pattern: 动词短语 + 的 + 名词
grammar.explanation: 的 (de) can turn a whole verb phrase into a description of a noun, like an English relative clause — "the book [that] I bought", "the person [who] is singing". The descriptive clause comes first, then 的, then the noun it modifies.

grammar.title: As soon as... then... with 一...就...
grammar.pattern: 一 + 动词1，就 + 动词2
grammar.explanation: 一...就... (yī...jiù...) links two actions that happen right after each other — "as soon as A happens, B happens". The first verb follows 一, and the second follows 就.

sentences.en: The food here is extremely delicious.
